title: check-delegation output
description: Compare what the parent zone publishes for a zone with what the zone needs at the registrar. Informational

resolver.description: The public resolver used; empty when none answered

parent.description: The enclosing zone that delegates this one, like com

parent_server.description: The parent name server that was asked

delegated.description: Whether the parent delegates the zone at all; null when no parent server answered

ns_expected.description: NS names the registrar should list

ns_missing.description: Expected NS names the parent does not list

ns_extra.description: NS names the parent lists that are not expected

glue.description: For each NS name inside the zone, the glue the parent should publish and does

ds_expected.description: SHA-256 DS records for the zone, empty when unsigned

ds_published.description: DS records at the parent; null when the resolver did not answer

ds_ok.description: Signed: every DS at the parent matches a key. Unsigned: the parent has no DS

resolution.description: How a validating resolver answers the zone SOA
